title: noccaea kurdica
intro: Noccaea kurdica, commonly known as Kurdistan pennywort or Kurdish penny cress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea kurdica are attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals and modulate the immune system, as well as its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
